lines.t: Rumpelstiltskin is tip toeing in his Jordans. And it's making everyone uncomfortable.

full.credit: Clips: Nunya Bizness; Official Dj.Solomo; Miss_Chiph (YouTube)

lines.t: This isn't from a real movie. It's AI, made to look like an 80s fantasy film.

full.credit: Clips: Nunya Bizness; Official Dj.Solomo; Miss_Chiph (YouTube)

lines.t: It was posted in August. Then in September, someone put it to a Riff Raff song, with a caption about taking too much melatonin.

full.credit: Clips: Nunya Bizness; Official Dj.Solomo; Miss_Chiph (YouTube)

lines.t: Now the dance means one thing: you're trolling. And people swap him with other characters.
